entry.summary:
How to add titles to your dealing in Landonline using the Advanced title selection panel.

0:00:23:17 Filter titles
0:01:02:09 Hide unlinked titles
0:01:15:14 Select titles from the list
0:01:39:25 Add title
0:02:05:14 Search for titles from other instruments
0:02:53:29 Copy titles from instruments in the dealing
0:03:26:09 Generate new titles
0:03:52:08 Close panel and check titles, and remove unwanted titles.

For more Landonline tutorials, check out:
https://www.linz.govt.nz/guidance/landonline-support/new-landonline-dealings-support/create-new-dealing
